scope: Versioned identity metadata file adapter, separate from musical projects
verified_behaviors: Hand-authored fixture with IDs above 2^53 and maximum uint64 cursor decodes without numeric rounding
Names, owners, scene references and allocation cursor survive encode/decode and on-disk save/reopen
Restore retains higher current allocation cursor; later duplicates use fresh identities
Unsupported fields/features/versions, malformed UTF-8/Unicode, oversized arrays/files and invalid references are rejected before replacing current state
Rejected loads preserve current metadata state; invalid writes and failed opens preserve the previous saved file
Maximum metadata entity/scene-entry workload with escaped 128-byte names and full-width IDs fits the 4 MiB byte budget
Desktop rejects metadata as a musical project while preserving tempo/path/history/saved state; codec rejects a real template project
Qt-first header inclusion compiles after C++ scene member rename to entries; serialized key remains slots
limits: Identity/ownership metadata only; no media/notes/tempo/mixer/device state in this format
No desktop document adoption, musical-state migration or general rendered-output equivalence
QSaveFile atomic replacement exercised for ordinary saves/failures; process-kill, disk-full, short-write and power-loss behavior remain unqualified
Document model and engine remain Qt-free; file adapter uses optional Qt Core outside the render callback
Issues #26/#56 retain integration work; no native UI/physical audio/release qualification claimed
Local host checks; hosted CI pending
